cllamaDescription.message: Browser AI copilot: deep webpage insights & Q&A, skill-powered multi-model chat. Works with Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini.

urlCssSelectorDesc.message: Content anchor uses CSS selectors to more accurately match page core content

skillListEmpty.message: No skills configured. Click "Add Skill" to create one.

skillToolsHint.message: Each tool is added as a row: pick the tool (its description shows automatically), fill optional default args as JSON, then save.

toolRowsEmpty.message: No tools yet. Click "Add Tool" to add one.

skillHelp.message: Skills are reusable capabilities (like the skills in cc / codex / cline). A skill injects a system prompt into the chat and may allow the model to call the tools you select below. In the chat sidebar, type "/" to pick and activate a skill.

skillPickerEmpty.message: No skills available. Add some in Settings → Skills.

skillDefaultCalculatorDesc.message: Do arithmetic using the add_numbers tool.

skillDefaultGeneralHelperDesc.message: Answer the user's questions based on the current webpage content.

tool_current_time_desc.message: Returns the current date and time in the user's locale.

tool_add_numbers_desc.message: Adds a list of numbers and returns the sum.

tool_echo_desc.message: Echoes back the exact text given in the text argument.

tool_fetch_url_desc.message: Fetches the text content of a URL and returns up to maxLen characters.

tranPrompt.message: Rewrite the user-supplied sentences or words to make them simpler. Note: the original meaning must be respected when rewriting.

cllamaError.message: Sorry, I encountered some problems. Please try again later or check if your cllama configuration information is correct.

urlPrefixError.message: Incorrect URL prefix input, must start with http or https

insightifyPageError1.message: Title and content are empty, cannot generate page-related information.

insightifyPageError2.message: Unable to process this page information. If you confirm the page is fine, please refresh and try again.

summaryPrompt.message: Please generate a brief summary based on the given page content. Requirements: 1. Maximum 300 words. 2. Always generate summary information in {localLanguage}.

exportOptionEmptyError.message: Please select at least one export option

importPromptMsg1.message: Please select your cllama data file for import

importWarnMsg1.message: Note: Importing will overwrite some existing data.

importFailMsg1.message: Import failed: No cllama data found in the file.

directorExample1_prompt.message:
You are an expert in LLM prompt generation. Please create a smart assistant prompt based on user requirements, guiding the LLM in content generation. Requirements:
 1. Output in Markdown format
 2. Align with user needs, describing the smart assistant's positioning, capabilities, and knowledge base
 3. The prompt should be clear, precise, and easy to understand, as concise as possible while maintaining quality
 4. Only output the prompt, no additional explanations

directorExample1_sample.message: Please help me generate a 'legal advisor' prompt

apiSettingsCreativityDesc.message: Higher values make responses more random and creative; lower values make them more stable and focused.

apiSettingsFocusDesc.message: Higher values make responses more unconventional; lower values make them more conservative and conventional.

confirmDelete.message: Are you sure you want to delete? Note: This action cannot be undone.

activate.message: If selected, send this file to AI service

fileTooLarge.message: File is too large, it is best not to exceed 1M.

TestDesc.message: For testing only, speed and stability are not guaranteed.

OtherDesc.message: Supports API interface services compatible with the OpenAI API protocol.

apiConfigGuidance.message: Please configure API information (e.g., API URL, API Key, etc.) first to use AI features properly.

thinkModeDesc.message: When enabled, AI models will show their thinking process. For models that support thinking (Ollama 0.9+).

tool_safe_calculate_desc.message: Safely evaluates a math expression using + - * / % ^ and parentheses.

tool_text_stats_desc.message: Returns statistics for a text: total chars, words, sentences and CJK characters.

tool_generate_uuid_desc.message: Generates a random UUID v4 string.

tool_random_number_desc.message: Returns a random integer between min and max.

tool_base64_encode_desc.message: Encodes the given text to base64 (UTF-8 safe).

tool_base64_decode_desc.message: Decodes a base64 string back to text (UTF-8 safe).

tool_get_browser_info_desc.message: Returns browser/system info: user agent, language, platform, timezone and timestamp.

tool_get_page_content_desc.message: Returns the content of the current webpage (title, url and text).

tool_convert_temperature_desc.message: Converts a temperature between Celsius (C), Fahrenheit (F) and Kelvin (K).

tool_convert_length_desc.message: Converts a length between m, cm, mm, km, in, ft, yd and mi.
